component_findings.examples_guides: Preserved paid evidence (ecosystem-tooling--part-3--java): Visit the Java Platform Standard Edition Technical Documentation site for information on new features and enhancements, Java Tutorials, Developer Guides, API documentation, and much more.
component_findings.generation_localization: Preserved paid evidence (ecosystem-tooling--part-3--java): Java scores at or near the ceiling for specification rigor, API reference completeness, and first-party Javadoc tooling (bundled in the JDK, actively enhanced, e.g. Markdown doc-comment support). Points are deducted because Oracle's flagship 'Java Tutorials' property is explicitly stuck at JDK 8 content and self-admittedly outdated, with the more current material fragmented onto a separate dev.java site; this split/legacy-content issue is a real, currently observable documentation-quality gap rather than a purely historical one.

component_findings.library_api: Preserved paid evidence (ecosystem-tooling--part-3--java): Frozen 0-100 proxy rubric, 20 pts each, applied identically to all 10 languages: (a) official versioned language/platform specification; (b) official comprehensive standard-library/API reference; (c) official tutorials/learning guides maintained by the language steward; (d) first-party in-source doc-comment generation tooling integrated into the toolchain; (e) currency/maintenance of official docs across current releases.
component_findings.version_navigation: Preserved paid evidence (ecosystem-tooling--part-3--java): Java has an official, versioned Java Language Specification hosted by Oracle (docs.oracle.com/javase/specs) that is updated per major JDK release.

metric.documentation_quality.limitations: The classic 'Java Tutorials' trail set (docs.oracle.com/javase/tutorial) is explicitly frozen at JDK 8 content and directs readers elsewhere for anything newer, which is a documented currency gap in the legacy tutorial property, though Oracle/OpenJDK now maintain a separate actively-updated learning site (dev.java) covering modern language features.
metric.documentation_quality.selection_rule: Prioritize official current-version documentation, then independently maintained supplementary material; community size alone is not documentation quality.
